description.value: Large turquoise gems stud the outer edge of this sturdy composite shortbow. Arrows shot from the bow are unimpaired by wind and air effects. You shoot an arrow at an open space on a surface within 500 feet and momentarily vanish into a wind that carries the arrow. You teleport to that location. You shoot an arrow at the sky and it tears an extraplanar rift that resembles a storm cloud in a 30-foot burst centered on a point within 200 feet. A torrent of rain pours down from the rift for 1 minute or until you Dismiss the effect. The area within the torrent becomes difficult terrain for all movement (including Flying). As an Interact action, you can fire an arrow into the rift to cause a bolt of lightning to strike a creature in the area. The creature takes 5d12 lightning damage and must attempt a DC 41 basic Reflex save. You fire a volley of arrows into the sky. You create the effects of a successful control weather ritual.
